title: 青岚风云 第140章 被青衣人跟踪深夜造访太子府青岚风云 第139章 借宿听竹小筑华灯初上灵州城
slug: 凡人修仙我能无限重生
content_zh:
直到深夜，两人才意犹未尽地返回住处。
正要走进客栈竹门，忽然身后闪出一道人影。
那人虽故意将自己隐藏街角，但林越是结丹期修为，神识强大远胜常人，依然发现了他的存在。
“小白，你先进去，我去处理点事情。”
林越将九尾灵狐送进客栈，自己则悄无声息地翻过院墙，将身影淹没在昏暗的黑夜中。
不多时，一阵脚步声由远及近传来，那道青衣身影在巷口迟疑了一瞬，还是迈步走了过来，躲在“听竹小筑”的院门外朝里观望着。
忽然，他的肩膀被人一拍。
“你跟了我两条街了，到底想要做什么？”
青衣身影回过头来，表情惊骇地看向林越，“你什么时候来到我身后的？”
“我问你的话，你还没有回答呢！”林越眼神冷峻。
青衣人的喉结上下滚了一下，片刻后他忽然笑了一下，“阁下果然敏锐，不愧是青岚宗的新晋长老。”
“你认识我？”林越微微惊讶。
青衣人拱了拱手，“在下姓沈，沈青山，大玄王朝太子府幕僚。”
“太子府的人，跟在我身后做什么？”林越沉声问。
沈青山的表情放松了几分，语气也不疾不徐地道，
“不瞒阁下，太子殿下听闻青岚宗有位年轻的林长老今日到了灵州城，特意派在下前来相邀。殿下想请林长老到东宫一叙，有要事相商。”
“你们的眼线真灵通啊，我今天刚到灵州城，你们就得知我的行踪啦！”林越眼神一凛，他最不喜欢的便是被人盯着。
“林长老息怒，太子殿下身为大玄王朝的东宫，要是没有点本事，还能坐稳东宫之位吗？实不相瞒，这灵州城的一举一动，哪怕是一根针掉在地上，也逃不出台子殿下的法眼。”沈青山赔笑道。
“嗯。你说的有道理。”林越点头，道，“太子殿下找我去东宫，有什么事吗？我和他可谓素不相识，从未交际……”
“殿下说了，林长老若肯赏光，殿下愿意资助林长老修筑正气长城之事，据我所知，林长老大老远到这灵州城来，不正是为了此事吗？”沈青山道。

“带路吧！”林越沉默了片刻，说道。
“跟我来！”沈青山说完，径直走在前面。
夜色如墨，街巷深处的灯火已经陆续熄灭，只剩下几盏零星的灯笼还挂在檐角，在夜风中轻轻摇晃。
沈青山走在前面，脚步不快，却速度不慢。这是多年习武练出的功底，不难看出，他是一位武道高手，身怀绝世轻功。
不过，这在结丹期的林越看来，根本不值一提，他施展云龙九现身法，不紧不慢地跟在沈青山身后。
两人一前一后穿过几条街巷，沈青山步伐越来越快，却始终甩不掉林越。他心中微微惊异，道，
“林长老，好腿法，不愧是修仙门派出身的，在下心服口服了。”
content_en:
It wasn't until late at night that the two of them returned to their residence still unfinished.
Just as he was about to walk into the bamboo door of the inn, suddenly a figure flashed out from behind him.
Although the man deliberately hid himself on the street corner, Lin Yue, who was in the alchemy stage of cultivation and whose spiritual consciousness was far more powerful than ordinary people, still discovered his existence.
"Xiao Bai, you go in first, I'll go handle something."
Lin Yue sent the nine-tailed fox into the inn, while he climbed over the courtyard wall quietly, submerging his figure in the dim night.
Not long after, a sound of footsteps came from far and near. The figure in green hesitated for a moment at the entrance of the alley, then walked over and hid outside the courtyard gate of "Tingzhu Xiaozhu" and looked in.
Suddenly, he was tapped on the shoulder.
"You've been following me for a long time. What do you want to do?"
The figure in Tsing Yi turned around and looked at Lin Yue with a horrified expression, "When did you come behind me?"
"If I asked you, you haven't answered yet!" Lin Yue's eyes were cold.
The man in Tsing Yi's Adam's apple rolled up and down, and after a moment he suddenly smiled, "Your Excellency is indeed keen, and you are worthy of being the new elder of the Qinglan Sect."
"You know me?" Lin Yue was slightly surprised.
The man in Tsing Yi cupped his hands and said, "My surname is Shen, Shen Qingshan, a staff member of the Prince's Mansion of the Daxuan Dynasty."
"What are the people from the Prince's Mansion doing behind me?" Lin Yue asked in a deep voice.
Shen Qingshan's expression relaxed a little, and his tone was calm and unhurried,
"To be honest with you, Your Highness the Crown Prince heard that a young Elder Lin from the Qinglan Sect arrived in Lingzhou City today, and specially sent me to invite him. Your Highness would like to invite Elder Lin to the East Palace to discuss important matters."
"You guys are so smart. As soon as I arrived in Lingzhou City today, you already knew my whereabouts!" Lin Yue's eyes narrowed. What he didn't like the most was being stared at.
"Elder Lin, calm down. As the East Palace of the Daxuan Dynasty, His Highness the Crown Prince, if he has no skills, can he still hold the position of the East Palace? To be honest, every move in Lingzhou City, even if a pin falls on the ground, cannot escape the eyes of His Highness Taizi." Shen Qingshan said with a smile.
"Yes. What you said makes sense." Lin Yue nodded and said, "His Royal Highness the Crown Prince asked me to go to the East Palace. What's the matter? It can be said that he and I are strangers and have never socialized..."
"His Highness said that if Elder Lin is willing to reward him, His Highness is willing to help Elder Lin build the Great Wall of Righteousness. As far as I know, isn't it just for this reason that Elder Lin came all the way to Lingzhou City?" Shen Qingshan said.
"Lead the way!" Lin Yue was silent for a moment and said.
"Follow me!" Shen Qingshan said and walked straight ahead.
The night is dark, and the lights in the deep streets and alleys have been extinguished one after another. Only a few scattered lanterns are still hanging on the corners of the eaves, swaying gently in the night wind.
Shen Qingshan walked in front, not fast, but not slow. This is the foundation of many years of martial arts training. It is not difficult to see that he is a martial arts master with unparalleled light skills.
However, in the eyes of Lin Yue, who was in the pill formation stage, this was not worth mentioning at all. He used the Yunlong Nine Appearance Technique and followed Shen Qingshan leisurely.
The two walked through several streets and alleys one after another. Shen Qingshan's pace became faster and faster, but he still couldn't get rid of Lin Yue. He was slightly surprised and said,
"Elder Lin, you have good kicking skills. You are worthy of being from the Immortal Cultivation Sect. I am convinced."
